build_task_template_unbox: build a PHYRE task template that creates an unbox puzzle with a slope, container, ball, and lid
create_convex_polygon_slope: create a convex polygon slope using C.add_convex_polygon with randomized vertex coordinates
add_container_goal: add a container body to the scene using vt.add_container with goal vertices and flip options
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene using C.add with randomized position and radius
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball and container to be TOUCHING using C.update_task
